<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
We found a new species of butterfly,
so we came to report!

Indeed I've never seen this, but...
wait, it vanished somewhere...!

I was holding it firmly...
when did it... I didn't notice at all.

This is...
yes, these wings have almost no friction.

One might call it the Smooth Butterfly.
This is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>You did it, Hunter!
A huge discovery!
